strings: Weakly, m_c thanks r_c0 for the herbs, only barely able to squint at {PRONOUN/r_c0/object}.
m_c curls up in the very back of the den. {PRONOUN/m_c/poss/CAP} head aches and pounds and even the dim lighting of the den is too much for {PRONOUN/m_c/object} today.

m_c whimpers in the glare of the sun. {PRONOUN/m_c/subject/CAP} {VERB/m_c/don't/doesn't} know how {PRONOUN/m_c/subject}{VERB/m_c/'re/'s} going to make it to the medicine den between the headache and all the squinting.

Thankfully for m_c, one of {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} Clanmates notices how out of it {PRONOUN/m_c/subject} {VERB/m_c/look/looks} and helps {PRONOUN/m_c/object} to the medicine den for some much needed headache-relieving herbs.
